reviews.comment: Dr. Capps is incredible. He is so passionate about his work and that makes it really easy to take his class. He is also really available outside of the classroom during his office hours and he will sit with you and answer all your questions until you understand. Pay attention in lecture, and show up to class so you can do the EQs (extra credit).

Dr. Capps is AMAZING!! He is a very caring guy who wants his students to succeed. The lectures are extremely long, but he is funny and makes them enjoyable. You have to study, there is not getting around that, but id you study the book chapter questions, AQs, and EQs you will be well prepared for exams.

This professor was not one of my top professors. His lectures are an hour and 15 minutes long, he reads off the slides half the time and the other half he goes on random tangents and stories about his life or the most random things. The very first day of class he told us he voted for Trump and continued to talk about it for the rest of the semester

Capps is a great person and made the extremely heavy lectures bearable. He gave extra credit that is basically worth a letter grade. However, the 30-question quizzes and 70-question tests are extremely difficult to study for. The final is cumulative and could be over any of the 290 plus questions from the tests and quizzes. Take online for an A

The BEST teacher for AGEC
- 10% extra credit for attending class
- like no homework
- just gotta study for quizzes and tests which aren't difficult if you put a little time in

Caring professor. Super funny guy. Super funny lectures. Down to earth. My favorite professor so far to be honest
He is tough but fair. You'll be fine if you go to class and the help sessions. A very hard class but there is lots of help available.

Probably the best professor I have had so far. Cares about his students. Difficult class but him and TA's offer a lot of help. He is very knowledgeable about AG Economics and Economics in general. Attendance quizzes can bump you a letter grade. Highly Recommend.

He can be very political but he definitely knows what he's talking about. Go to class because a lot of test questions are straight from the lectures and the daily quizzes are the best way to earn extra credit! There are review sessions before tests which can be helpful if you have any questions!

Expect lots of work for this class. Attendance is 10% extra credit, but the FRQs and tests have many random questions that make it hard for you to get it right. He sometimes rants, and this class is very skippable. No matter how much you study, it is very hard to get an A. Expect weekly pop quizzes and a cumulative exam at the end.

great prof but the class is hard, even if you try. has been teaching this class for like 30 years so very no nonsense and doesn't fall for common college kid tricks to get extensions or make ups for exams. however great prof because he lays out everything for the semester. do the EQ and AQ and u will be fine
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Capps is a great professor that will do anything to help his students.
Great professor!

Dr. Capps is truly one of a kind. He wants each student to succeed in his class as well as life. Attendance isn't mandatory, but is encouraged (extra credit points). Overall, his quizzes and tests are very similar to ones in the past. He gives you all resources to be successful. Definitely take him; he's amazing!

Professor Capps is awesome and unlike most professors around the country, he is a true American patriot. While attendance is not mandatory, it is encouraged due to the 40 extra credit points he offers. Make sure you study hard for every quiz and exam because everything is straight from the lecture notes and textbook problems.

He often goes on rants that have nothing to do with the course. EC is offered in class so you feel like you have to go, but it wasn't worth it a lot of times. He has his opinions about topics and he will let you know. Read the textbook, it really helps a lot. Study outside of class since there are no outside assignments, just quizzes and tests.

Dr. Capps is a wonderful professor. He cares about what the student learn and he encourages them to think form themselves. He is very funny and his lectures are entertaining. He explains basic economic principles very well, but sometimes he goes fairly fast. He also gives up to 40 bonus points at the end of the semester. 10/10 professor.

By far the best prof I had this semester. Hes super chill, gives a max of 40 extra points to get a whole letter grade up, and is hilarious. Tests are pretty long but actually study the material and your good. All-n-all take his class,

Dr. Capps really cares about his students and his subject. There are non-mandatory EQs that can gain you 40 extra credit points, five AQs (he drops the lowest one), and three exams counting the final. As long as you understand the basic economic principles behind the coursework, this subject isn't very hard at all.

There is so much that I could say about Dr. Capps but my characters are limited. If you need AGEC 105, take it with this man. Seriously! Here's the kicker: Go to class. He gives more extra credit than anybody on campus, and it's easy to get! If you take will just halfway listen to him each week and DO the Practice Exams, you will make an A.

Goes on long rants throughout the lectures that have absolutely nothing to do with the topic which can make things very confusing. Hard to pass if you don't show up to class due to EC he gives. DOES NOT curve, even a 79.5
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr Capps gave his students every opportunity to get an A. He gave SO MUCH extra credit and posted reviews for each exam and each quiz, only 5 quizzes. The reviews are exactly like the quiz and/or exam so studying the reviews and the chapter questions in the textbook will make getting an A in this class easy. I studied about 3-5 hrs a month.

Dr. Capps provides extra credit quizzes every day you don't have a major quiz or exam. His announced quizzes are tough and fill in the blank but his exams are easier because they are similar to the previous year's exams that he posts. Attendance is mandatory but the benefit is getting extra credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT
